frequency of reviewing specific aspects of the informed consent process (e.g., who performs procedure, trainee involvement, alternative treatments, documentation)

cohort.0: A total of 281 obstetrics and gynecology residents completed an electronic survey.

finding.0: Increasing postgraduate year was significantly associated with increasing confidence in obtaining informed consent, yet nearly 90% of trainees reported obtaining IC for procedures for which they were unsure of all risks and over 60% desired more training.

cross-section timing.0: Data was collected via an electronic survey completed by obstetrics and gynecology residents at a single point in time.
